Last reviewed: Nov 12, 2026 (M. Okafor)

## Universe
Liquid large and mid cap software, semis, and hardware names on the approved universe list. New names require Compliance review before first trade.

## Sizing
- Max 2% NAV per name intraday
- Stop at -1.5% from entry
- Target 3-5% holding period for momentum setups

- Relative volume > 1.8x 20d average
- Gap moves at open confirmed by NBBO depth

The playbook's escalation rule applies, so I have not used this record in any analysis or order.

- Escalate to Compliance at ext. 4471 today.
- Ask Compliance to confirm how an internal draft reached the external feed log, and whether the feed needs to be purged or quarantined.
- Restrict trading in QCOM and KPTX until Compliance clears it. Check whether the desk or any of its counterparties have traded either name since the record was logged.
- Don't pass this information to other desk members or into other strategies.
